source_snapshot.criteria: Normal operation, slot-specific correctable event in BMC and optional UEFI, both fault indicators off, and Cscript explicitly identifies Patrol Scrub Error.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly reserves injection for FAE control, but the grep is not proof of Cscript Patrol Scrub classification, assumes Linux dmesg after Windows, truncates evidence and cannot verify indicators.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats the two consume flags and exact Cscript classification as case-defining evidence.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Targeted injection requires exact package semantics, topology, bounded execution, no retry and engineer verdict.

original_test_intent: Cause a correctable memory error to be consumed through the patrol-scrub path on each approved memory controller, prove the Intel harness labels it Patrol Scrub, correlate the correct physical slot across OS/BMC/UEFI and confirm normal operation with both fault indicators off.
original_method: An FAE/operator maps each controller to a DIMM tuple, verifies how `immConsume=True` interacts with `PatrolConsume=True`, enables the approved BIOS settings and performs one injection per target. The full Cscript transcript must demonstrate patrol-scrub consumption, while read-only evidence confirms slot attribution, no-light behavior, health and restored settings.
manual_activity: The FAE/operator must validate controller/DIMM mapping and consume-flag behavior, configure/restore BIOS, run one approved injection per controller and visually confirm both indicators remain off. Agent cannot infer that a generic corrected error was patrol-scrub consumed.
required_inputs: Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash and authoritative immConsume/PatrolConsume interaction
Per-controller/rank coverage matrix and bounded injection count
Exact Cscript Patrol Scrub string/fields and authoritative Windows/BMC/UEFI slot oracle
Indicator applicability, recovery and restoration checklist
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, console and FAE approval
Preserve baseline evidence; do not clear logs
Verify tuple and flags before a single injection per target
Stop on wrong slot/severity, absence of Patrol Scrub classification, error storm, lamp assertion or instability
No automatic retry; restore settings and validate memory health before another target
agent_execution_scope: Capture topology, full approved Cscript output and non-mutating OS/BMC/UEFI evidence
Do not choose flags/tuples, alter BIOS, inject, clear evidence, recover/repeat or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve mapping, rank coverage and flag semantics
Define the mandatory Patrol Scrub Cscript oracle and Windows evidence source
Set BMC/UEFI slot fields and indicator applicability

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SSH grep may find generic scrub/CE text but cannot prove the harness consumed this event via Patrol Scrub; it conflicts with Windows, omits full Cscript/UEFI/indicator evidence and weakens SSH trust.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact FAE-operated `injectMemError(..., rank=0, errType="ce", immConsume=True, PatrolConsume=True)` only after both flag semantics are approved; retain the complete Cscript classification output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both True flags, CE, rank 0, Memory controller 1~N and 15/10-minute estimates remain literal rather than normalizing the command.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each controller tuple to `mc.dimminfo()`, record pre-scrub state, execute one approved injection, retain full Cscript output proving Patrol Scrub consumption, correlate address/slot across Windows/BMC/UEFI, photograph off indicators and diff restored BIOS/health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a deterministic consumption-path oracle and coverage matrix without changing the two source flags.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic CE record establishes correction but not Patrol Scrub consumption; missing Cscript classification would lose the row's defining coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported flag combinations may consume immediately through another path, create an error storm or destabilize firmware instead of exercising patrol scrub.

project_override_considerations: The case is hybrid package/user-confirmed work; the agent cannot select semantics or execute the fault. Missing flag documentation or topology blocks the run, not the static review.
expected_evidence: Package hash, full topology and controller-to-tuple/rank matrix
Per-target command plus untruncated Cscript output explicitly proving Patrol Scrub Error
Authoritative Windows correctable/patrol evidence and matching BMC/applicable UEFI slot entry
Front-panel/DIMM-lightpath off evidence, health, BIOS restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Controller 1~N is represented by one fixed-rank DIMM tuple without a coverage matrix. The source does not explain why immediate and patrol consumption are both True or how Patrol Scrub is distinguished. Windows/dmesg and optional UEFI/indicator applicability remain inconsistent or undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Patrol Scrub purpose and source command are identifiable; vendor/FAE flag semantics, topology and evidence contracts can resolve readiness, so execution is gated rather than irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 15 Wistron-System RAS-00735-V003: approve controller-to-DIMM/rank coverage, Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and the simultaneous `immConsume=True, PatrolConsume=True` semantics; define the exact Cscript evidence that proves Patrol Scrub rather than immediate/generic CE; reconcile Windows with dmesg; specify BMC/UEFI slot fields, indicator applicability/off state, abort/recovery and BIOS restoration.

review_improvement: The review protects the case's defining Patrol Scrub consumption path instead of accepting any correctable ECC record as equivalent evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Patrol scrub normally discovers or consumes a latent error through a background scrub operation, whereas `immConsume=True` suggests immediate consumption. With both booleans asserted, only the supported harness documentation and full Cscript output can show which path actually fired; keyword grep is insufficient. Controller-level coverage also cannot be inferred from one rank-0 DIMM tuple. Since Windows is the specified OS, its approved RAS evidence must replace assumed dmesg, while the physical off states need explicit applicability. These are resolvable project/package gates, supporting REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
